title: Overnight oats with berries
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt and chia seeds together in a jar.
Cover and chill overnight.
Top with berries and honey before serving.

title: Scrambled eggs on toast
steps: Whisk the eggs with a pinch of salt.
Melt butter in a pan over low heat and add the eggs.
Stir gently until just set.
Toast the bread and pile the eggs on top with chives.

title: Bircher muesli
steps: Soak the oats in milk for at least 10 minutes.
Coarsely grate the apple and toss with lemon juice.
Fold apple and yogurt into the oats.
Sweeten with honey and scatter chopped hazelnuts on top.

title: Fluffy pancakes with maple syrup
steps: Mix flour, sugar and baking powder.
Whisk in milk, egg and half of the melted butter until smooth.
Fry small pancakes in the remaining butter until golden on both sides.
Serve stacked with maple syrup.

title: Bread rolls with ham and cheese
steps: Slice the rolls and spread with butter.
Lay ham and cheese on the bottom halves.
Add sliced cucumber and close the rolls.

title: Greek yogurt with walnuts and honey
steps: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl.
Top with berries and roughly chopped walnuts.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Avocado toast with poached egg
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Poach the egg in gently simmering water for 3-4 minutes.
Spread avocado on the toast, top with the egg and chili flakes.

title: Shakshuka
steps: Saute diced onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, cumin and paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Make two hollows, crack in the eggs, cover and cook until the whites set.
Crumble feta and parsley over the top.

title: Full English breakfast
steps: Fry the sausage in oil for about 12 minutes, turning often.
Add bacon, halved tomato and mushrooms to the pan and cook until done.
Warm the beans in a small pot.
Fry the egg and toast the bread.
Arrange everything on a warm plate.

title: Berry smoothie bowl
steps: Blend banana, frozen berries and oat milk until thick.
Pour into a bowl.
Sprinkle with oats and chia seeds.

title: Apple cinnamon porridge
steps: Simmer oats in oat milk for 5 minutes, stirring.
Dice the apple and stir half into the porridge with the cinnamon.
Top with the remaining apple and maple syrup.

title: Strammer Max
steps: Butter the bread and cover each slice with ham.
Fry the eggs sunny side up in the remaining butter.
Slide an egg onto each slice and sprinkle with chives.

title: French toast
steps: Whisk egg, milk and cinnamon in a shallow dish.
Soak the bread slices briefly on both sides.
Fry in butter until golden.
Serve with maple syrup.

title: Homemade granola with yogurt
steps: Heat the oven to 160 C.
Mix oats, chopped almonds, cinnamon, honey and oil.
Spread on a tray and bake for about 25 minutes, stirring halfway.
Let cool until crisp and serve over yogurt.

title: Quark with berries and linseed
steps: Stir the quark until creamy, adding a splash of water if needed.
Top with berries and linseed.
Drizzle with honey.

title: Croissant with butter and jam
steps: Warm the croissant in the oven at 160 C for 3 minutes.
Split it open.
Spread with butter and jam.

title: Eggs Benedict
steps: Melt the butter.
Whisk one egg yolk with lemon juice over a water bath, then slowly beat in the butter to make hollandaise.
Poach the remaining two eggs.
Toast the muffin halves and top with ham.
Add the poached eggs and spoon the sauce over.

title: Tofu scramble
steps: Crumble the tofu with your hands.
Fry it in olive oil with turmeric for 5 minutes.
Add diced tomato and spinach and cook until wilted.
Season and serve with toasted bread.

title: Rye bread with smoked salmon
steps: Spread the bread with cream cheese.
Top with salmon and thin cucumber slices.
Finish with dill and black pepper.

title: Mango chia pudding
steps: Stir chia seeds into the oat milk with maple syrup.
Stir again after 5 minutes, then chill overnight.
Top with diced mango.

title: Cinnamon rolls
steps: Knead flour, warm milk, yeast, half the sugar and half the butter into a soft dough and let rise for 1 hour.
Roll out, brush with the remaining butter and sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar.
Roll up, cut into slices and let rise for 20 minutes in a tin.
Bake at 180 C for about 22 minutes.
Drizzle with icing made from powdered sugar and a little water.

title: Green smoothie
steps: Wash the spinach and core the apple.
Put everything in a blender.
Blend until completely smooth and drink right away.

title: Hummus with vegetable sticks
steps: Peel the carrot.
Cut carrot, cucumber and pepper into sticks.
Serve with the hummus for dipping.

title: Apple with peanut butter
steps: Core the apple and cut into wedges.
Stir the peanut butter until smooth.
Serve the wedges with peanut butter for dipping.

title: Date and oat energy balls
steps: Blend dates, oats, almonds and cocoa in a food processor until sticky.
Roll into small balls with damp hands.
Chill for 10 minutes before eating.

title: Crispy roasted chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C.
Drain chickpeas and pat very dry.
Toss with oil, paprika and salt.
Roast for 30 minutes, shaking the tray once.

title: Caprese skewers
steps: Cut the mozzarella into bite-sized pieces.
Thread tomatoes, basil leaves and mozzarella onto small skewers.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.

title: Chocolate chip cookies
steps: Heat the oven to 180 C.
Cream butter and sugar, then beat in the egg.
Stir in flour, baking powder and chopped chocolate.
Place small mounds on a tray and bake for 10-12 minutes.

title: Rice cakes with cottage cheese
steps: Slice the cucumber thinly.
Spread cottage cheese on the rice cakes.
Top with cucumber, chives and black pepper.

title: Guacamole with tortilla chips
steps: Mash the avocado with lime juice and salt.
Stir in finely diced tomato and onion.
Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Butter pretzel
steps: Warm the pretzel briefly in the oven if you like.
Slice it horizontally.
Spread generously with cold butter.

title: Fresh fruit salad
steps: Peel the orange and banana.
Cut all the fruit into bite-sized pieces.
Toss with lemon juice to keep it fresh.

title: Devilled eggs
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes and cool in cold water.
Peel, halve and remove the yolks.
Mash the yolks with mayonnaise, mustard and salt.
Pipe or spoon back into the whites and dust with paprika.

title: Apple cake
steps: Heat the oven to 175 C and grease a springform tin.
Beat butter and sugar, add eggs, then fold in flour and baking powder.
Spread the batter in the tin and press in apple slices.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and bake for about 45 minutes.

title: Stovetop popcorn
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot with a lid.
Add the kernels, cover and shake the pot occasionally.
Remove from the heat once popping slows and season with salt.

title: Tomato bruschetta
steps: Dice the tomato and mix with chopped basil, half the oil and salt.
Slice and toast the baguette.
Rub the toast with a cut garlic clove and drizzle with remaining oil.
Spoon the tomato mixture on top.

title: Edamame with sea salt
steps: Bring a pot of salted water to the boil.
Cook the edamame for 4-5 minutes.
Drain and sprinkle with coarse sea salt.

title: Spaghetti aglio e olio
steps: Boil the pasta in salted water.
Gently fry thinly sliced garlic and chili in olive oil until pale golden.
Toss the drained pasta in the oil with a splash of pasta water.
Finish with chopped parsley.

title: Spaghetti bolognese
steps: Finely dice onion, carrot and celery and soften in olive oil.
Add the beef and brown well.
Stir in garlic and tomato paste, then the tomatoes.
Simmer for at least 40 minutes, adding water if needed.
Serve over the cooked spaghetti with parmesan.

title: Chili con carne
steps: Brown the beef with diced onion in oil.
Add garlic, pepper and spices and cook for 2 minutes.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in beans and corn and simmer for 10 more minutes.

title: Chili sin carne
steps: Soften diced onion and pepper in oil.
Add garlic and spices and cook briefly.
Add tomatoes, beans and corn.
Simmer for 25 minutes until thick.

title: Wiener Schnitzel with potato salad
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins, peel and slice while warm.
Pour warm broth, vinegar, oil and finely diced onion over the potatoes and let them soak.
Pound the veal thin, then coat in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot clarified butter until golden on both sides.
Serve with the potato salad and a lemon wedge.

title: Chicken curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry onion, garlic and ginger in oil until soft.
Add diced chicken and curry powder and brown lightly.
Pour in tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes.
Serve with the rice.

title: Red lentil dal with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry onion, garlic, ginger and spices in oil.
Add lentils, tomatoes and 300 ml water.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils break down.
Stir in the coconut milk and serve with rice.

title: Greek salad
steps: Cut tomatoes, cucumber and pepper into chunks.
Add thinly sliced onion and olives.
Place the feta on top.
Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with oregano.

title: Salmon with dill potatoes and green beans
steps: Boil the potatoes until tender.
Steam the green beans for 6-8 minutes.
Fry the salmon skin side down for 5 minutes, then turn briefly.
Toss the potatoes with butter and dill and serve with salmon, beans and lemon.

title: Fish fingers with mashed potatoes and peas
steps: Boil peeled potatoes until soft.
Bake or fry the fish fingers as directed on the pack.
Cook the peas for 3 minutes.
Mash potatoes with warm milk and butter and serve everything together.

title: Kaesespaetzle
steps: Beat flour, egg, salt and about 40 ml water into a thick batter.
Press the batter through a spaetzle maker into boiling salted water and lift out once they float.
Fry sliced onion in butter until deep golden.
Layer spaetzle with grated cheese in a warm dish and top with the onions.

title: Potato soup with frankfurters
steps: Dice all the vegetables.
Sweat onion and leek in oil, add the rest of the vegetables and broth.
Simmer for 25 minutes and mash roughly.
Add sliced frankfurter and marjoram and heat through.

title: Vegetable stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice.
Cut the vegetables into thin strips and small florets.
Stir-fry garlic and ginger in hot sesame oil, then add the vegetables.
Cook for 5 minutes, add soy sauce and serve over rice.

title: Chicken fajitas
steps: Slice chicken, pepper and onion into strips.
Toss the chicken with spices, oil and lime juice.
Fry chicken over high heat, then add the vegetables until slightly charred.
Serve in warm tortillas with sour cream.

title: Homemade pizza Margherita
steps: Knead flour, yeast, oil, salt and 75 ml warm water into a smooth dough.
Let rise for 1 hour.
Heat the oven as hot as it goes.
Stretch the dough, spread with passata and top with torn mozzarella.
Bake for 10-12 minutes and finish with basil.

title: Roast chicken legs with vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C.
Cut potatoes, carrots and onion into chunks and toss with oil, rosemary and garlic.
Place the seasoned chicken leg on top.
Roast for about 60 minutes until the skin is crisp and the juices run clear.

title: Beef goulash with potatoes
steps: Brown the beef cubes in oil in batches.
Add plenty of sliced onion and cook until soft.
Stir in paprika, tomato paste and caraway.
Pour in the broth, cover and braise gently for 2 hours.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

title: Beef roulades
steps: Spread the beef slices with mustard and layer with bacon, onion and gherkin.
Roll up tightly and secure with string.
Brown on all sides in oil.
Deglaze with wine and broth, cover and braise for 90 minutes.
Thicken the sauce and serve with boiled potatoes.

title: Minestrone
steps: Dice all the vegetables.
Soften onion, carrot and celery in olive oil.
Add garlic, potatoes, zucchini, tomatoes and broth and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add pasta and beans and cook until the pasta is tender.

title: Tuna pasta salad
steps: Cook the pasta and rinse under cold water.
Mix yogurt and mayonnaise into a dressing.
Combine pasta, flaked tuna, corn, halved tomatoes and chopped onion.
Toss with the dressing and season.

title: Penne arrabbiata
steps: Cook the penne.
Fry garlic and chili in olive oil for a minute.
Add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and parsley.

title: Beef lasagne
steps: Make a meat sauce with onion, carrot, garlic, beef and tomatoes and simmer for 20 minutes.
Make a bechamel from butter, flour and milk.
Layer sheets, meat sauce and bechamel in a dish, finishing with bechamel.
Sprinkle with parmesan and bake at 180 C for 40 minutes.

title: Vegetable lasagne
steps: Fry onion, garlic and diced zucchini in olive oil, then add tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes.
Wilt the spinach and mix with ricotta.
Layer sheets, tomato sauce and spinach ricotta in a dish.
Top with mozzarella and bake at 180 C for 40 minutes.

title: Hearty lentil stew
steps: Dice all the vegetables.
Sweat onion and leek in oil.
Add lentils, the remaining vegetables and broth and simmer for 35 minutes.
Season with marjoram and a dash of vinegar.

title: Pumpkin soup
steps: Dice pumpkin (skin on), carrot and onion.
Sweat with ginger in oil, then add broth.
Simmer for 20 minutes and blend until smooth.
Stir in coconut milk and top with toasted pumpkin seeds.

title: Chicken noodle soup
steps: Simmer the chicken in the broth for 20 minutes, then lift out and shred.
Add sliced carrot, celery and leek and cook for 10 minutes.
Add noodles and cook until tender.
Return the chicken and finish with parsley.

title: Chicken Caesar salad
steps: Fry the chicken in half the oil and slice.
Cube the bread and toast in the remaining oil to make croutons.
Whisk mayonnaise, lemon juice, grated garlic, mustard and half the parmesan into a dressing.
Toss the lettuce with dressing and top with chicken, croutons and remaining parmesan.

title: Falafel wrap
steps: Blitz chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin and flour into a coarse paste.
Shape small patties and fry in oil until crisp.
Thin the tahini with water and a pinch of salt.
Fill the tortilla with lettuce, tomato and falafel and drizzle with tahini.

title: Bratwurst with sauerkraut and mash
steps: Boil peeled potatoes until soft.
Warm the sauerkraut with a little water.
Fry the bratwurst until browned all over.
Mash the potatoes with milk and butter and serve together.

title: Chicken teriyaki with rice
steps: Cook the rice and steam the broccoli.
Fry the chicken pieces in oil until golden.
Add soy sauce, honey, ginger and garlic and reduce to a sticky glaze.
Serve over rice with broccoli and sesame seeds.

title: Garlic shrimp spaghetti
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Fry garlic and chili in olive oil, then add shrimp for 2-3 minutes.
Add halved tomatoes and cook until just soft.
Toss with pasta, lemon juice and parsley.

title: Cod in mustard sauce
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Melt butter, stir in flour, then whisk in milk and simmer until thick.
Season the sauce with mustard and dill.
Poach the cod gently in the sauce for 8 minutes and serve with potatoes.

title: Roasted Mediterranean vegetables with feta
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C.
Cut the vegetables into chunks and toss with oil, oregano and salt.
Roast for 25 minutes.
Crumble feta over and roast for 10 more minutes.

title: Stuffed bell peppers
steps: Parboil the rice for 10 minutes.
Mix beef, rice, diced onion, paprika and salt.
Cut the tops off the peppers, fill them and stand in a dish.
Pour the tomatoes around, sprinkle with cheese and bake at 180 C for 40 minutes.

title: Mushroom risotto
steps: Fry sliced mushrooms in olive oil until browned and set aside.
Soften onion in half the butter, add the rice and toast briefly.
Deglaze with wine, then add hot broth ladle by ladle, stirring, for about 18 minutes.
Stir in mushrooms, remaining butter and parmesan.

title: Flammkuchen
steps: Heat the oven to its highest setting.
Knead flour, oil, salt and about 55 ml water into a dough and roll out very thinly.
Spread with creme fraiche and top with sliced onion and bacon strips.
Bake for 10-12 minutes until crisp.

title: Potato pancakes with apple sauce
steps: Grate potatoes and onion and squeeze out the liquid.
Mix with egg, flour and salt.
Fry thin pancakes in hot oil until crisp on both sides.
Drain on paper and serve with apple sauce.

title: Boiled potatoes with herb quark
steps: Boil the potatoes in their skins for about 20 minutes.
Stir quark with herbs, grated garlic and a splash of water until creamy.
Serve the potatoes with the quark and a drizzle of linseed oil.

title: Cheeseburger with fries
steps: Cut the potatoes into fries, toss with oil and bake at 220 C for 30 minutes.
Shape the beef into a patty and season well.
Fry the patty for 3-4 minutes per side, adding cheese at the end.
Toast the bun and build the burger with lettuce, tomato, onion and ketchup.

title: Turkey noodle stir-fry
steps: Cook the noodles and drain.
Stir-fry turkey strips in hot oil until golden.
Add ginger, sliced vegetables and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Toss in the noodles and soy sauce.

title: Chickpea and spinach curry
steps: Cook the rice.
Soften onion, garlic and ginger in a splash of water or oil, then add curry powder.
Add tomatoes, chickpeas and coconut milk and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted.

title: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Rub butter into flour, add a little cold water and chill the dough for 20 minutes.
Roll out, line a tart tin and blind bake at 190 C for 10 minutes.
Fry the bacon and scatter over the base with grated cheese.
Pour over egg beaten with cream and bake for 30 minutes.

title: Ratatouille with baguette
steps: Cut all vegetables into even cubes.
Brown eggplant and zucchini in batches in olive oil.
Soften onion, pepper and garlic, then add tomatoes and thyme.
Return everything to the pot and simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve with baguette.

title: Thai green curry with chicken
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry the curry paste in a little coconut milk until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook for 3 minutes.
Add remaining coconut milk and vegetables and simmer for 8 minutes.
Season with fish sauce and basil and serve with rice.

title: Spaghetti with basil pesto
steps: Cook the spaghetti.
Toss with pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Top with halved tomatoes and parmesan.

title: Pan-fried trout with almond butter
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Dust the trout in flour and fry in half the butter for 3 minutes per side.
Brown the almonds in the remaining butter.
Pour the almond butter over the fish and serve with potatoes, lemon and parsley.

title: Shepherd's pie
steps: Brown the lamb with diced onion and carrot.
Add tomato paste, worcestershire sauce and broth and simmer for 20 minutes, then stir in peas.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter and milk.
Spread the mash over the meat in a dish and bake at 200 C for 25 minutes.

title: Quinoa Buddha bowl
steps: Rinse and cook the quinoa.
Roast diced sweet potato and chickpeas with oil at 200 C for 25 minutes.
Whisk tahini, lemon juice and water into a dressing.
Arrange quinoa, spinach, roasted veg and avocado in a bowl and drizzle with dressing.

title: Cabbage rolls in tomato sauce
steps: Blanch whole cabbage leaves until pliable.
Mix the meat with diced onion, breadcrumbs, egg and seasoning.
Wrap the filling in the leaves and tie or secure.
Brown the rolls in oil, add broth and tomato paste and braise covered for 50 minutes.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

title: Spinach with fried eggs and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes.
Soften onion in half the butter, add spinach and wilt.
Chop the spinach finely and stir in cream and nutmeg.
Fry the eggs in the remaining butter and serve with spinach and potatoes.

title: Pork tenderloin with mushroom cream sauce
steps: Cook the tagliatelle.
Sear medallions of pork in oil for 3 minutes per side and rest them.
Fry onion and mushrooms in the same pan.
Add cream, simmer briefly and return the pork to warm through.
Serve with the pasta.

title: Asian noodle soup with tofu
steps: Heat the broth with ginger and soy sauce.
Fry cubed tofu in sesame oil until golden.
Add mushrooms and bok choy to the broth and simmer for 4 minutes.
Soak the noodles, place in a bowl and ladle the soup over with tofu and spring onion.

title: Tortellini with ham and cream sauce
steps: Cook the tortellini as directed.
Warm strips of ham, peas and cream in a pan.
Toss the tortellini in the sauce and finish with parmesan.

title: Club sandwich
steps: Fry the chicken and bacon and slice the chicken.
Toast the bread and spread with mayonnaise.
Layer chicken, bacon, lettuce and tomato between the three slices.
Cut diagonally and hold together with cocktail sticks.

title: Beetroot and goat cheese salad
steps: Slice the beetroot.
Whisk oil, vinegar and honey into a dressing.
Arrange rocket and beetroot on a plate.
Top with crumbled goat cheese and walnuts and drizzle with dressing.

title: Kaiserschmarrn
steps: Whisk flour, milk, yolks and sugar; beat the whites stiff and fold in.
Pour into a hot buttered pan, scatter raisins and cook until the base is golden.
Turn in sections, then tear into pieces with two forks.
Caramelise briefly with a little more butter and sugar.
Dust with powdered sugar and serve with apple sauce.

title: Shrimp pad thai
steps: Soak the noodles in hot water until pliable.
Mix fish sauce, tamarind and sugar.
Stir-fry the shrimp in oil, push aside and scramble the egg.
Add noodles and sauce and toss until coated.
Fold in sprouts and spring onion and top with peanuts and lime.

title: Moussaka
steps: Slice the eggplant, brush with oil and roast at 200 C until soft.
Brown the lamb with onion and garlic, add tomatoes and cinnamon and simmer for 20 minutes.
Make a bechamel with butter, flour and milk and stir in half the cheese.
Layer eggplant and meat sauce, top with bechamel and remaining cheese.
Bake at 180 C for 40 minutes and rest before cutting.

title: Baked feta pasta
steps: Heat the oven to 200 C.
Put tomatoes in a dish with the feta block in the middle, add garlic and oil.
Bake for 25 minutes while the pasta cooks.
Mash feta and tomatoes into a sauce, toss with pasta and basil.

title: Seafood paella
steps: Soften onion, pepper and garlic in olive oil in a wide pan.
Stir in rice, paprika and saffron.
Pour in hot broth and simmer without stirring for 15 minutes.
Press in shrimp, mussels and peas and cook covered for 8 minutes until the mussels open.
Rest for 5 minutes and serve with lemon.

title: Ham and mushroom omelette
steps: Fry sliced mushrooms in half the butter until golden.
Add diced ham and warm through.
Pour in the beaten eggs with the remaining butter and cook on medium heat.
Fold, sprinkle with chives and serve.

title: Hash browns with bacon and egg
steps: Coarsely grate the potatoes and squeeze out the liquid.
Mix with finely chopped onion and salt.
Fry flat patties in oil for about 5 minutes per side until crisp.
Fry the bacon and the egg and serve on top.

title: Breakfast burrito with chorizo
steps: Fry the diced chorizo until crisp and lift out.
Scramble the eggs in the chorizo fat.
Warm beans and tortilla.
Fill the tortilla with eggs, chorizo, beans, cheese, tomato and avocado and roll up.

title: Smoked salmon cucumber bites
steps: Cut the cucumber into thick slices.
Spread each slice with a little cream cheese.
Top with a curl of salmon and a sprig of dill.

title: Chicken satay skewers
steps: Cut the chicken into strips and marinate with soy sauce, curry powder and honey for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill or pan-fry for 6-8 minutes.
Warm peanut butter with coconut milk and lime juice into a sauce.
Serve the skewers with the dip.

title: German meatballs with potato salad
steps: Boil the potatoes, peel and slice while warm.
Dress them with warm broth, vinegar, half the onion and sliced gherkin.
Soak the roll in water, squeeze out and mix with the meat, egg, mustard and the remaining onion.
Shape flat patties and fry in oil for about 5 minutes per side.

title: Chicken fricassee with rice
steps: Simmer the chicken in the broth for 15 minutes, then dice it and keep the broth.
Cook the rice.
Make a roux from butter and flour and whisk in the broth.
Add mushrooms, peas, cream and chicken and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with lemon juice and serve with rice.

title: Koenigsberg meatballs in caper sauce
steps: Mix the meat with soaked roll, diced onion, egg and seasoning and shape into balls.
Simmer the meatballs gently in the broth for 15 minutes, then lift out.
Make a roux, whisk in the hot broth and simmer until smooth.
Add capers and cream and return the meatballs.
Serve with boiled potatoes.

title: Matjes herring with green beans and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes and the green beans separately.
Fry diced bacon and onion in butter until golden.
Toss the beans in the bacon mixture.
Serve with the matjes fillets and potatoes.

title: Chicken drumsticks with sweet potato wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 210 C.
Rub the drumsticks with half the oil, paprika and salt.
Cut sweet potatoes into wedges and toss with the remaining oil.
Roast everything on one tray for about 40 minutes.
Serve with yogurt mixed with grated garlic.

title: Pork chops with green beans and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes and steam the green beans.
Season the chop and fry in oil for 4-5 minutes per side.
Rest the meat for a few minutes.
Toss the beans with butter and garlic and serve everything together.

title: Coconut fish curry
steps: Cook the rice.
Fry onion, garlic, ginger and curry powder in oil.
Add tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add chunks of fish and spinach and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Serve over rice.

title: Pulled pork buns with coleslaw
steps: Rub the pork with paprika, sugar and salt.
Roast covered at 150 C for about 4 hours until it falls apart.
Shred the meat and mix with bbq sauce.
Toss finely shredded cabbage and grated carrot with mayonnaise.
Pile pork and slaw into toasted buns.

title: Chicken schnitzel with cucumber salad
steps: Slice the cucumber thinly and mix with yogurt, dill and salt.
Pound the chicken thin.
Coat in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs.
Fry in hot oil for 3-4 minutes per side until golden.

title: Chicken shawarma couscous bowl
steps: Toss the chicken with spices, half the oil and salt and leave for 10 minutes.
Soak the couscous in boiling salted water for 5 minutes.
Fry the chicken in the remaining oil until charred and slice.
Stir grated garlic into the yogurt.
Serve couscous with chicken, diced cucumber, tomato and garlic yogurt.
